item.title: DeepSeek 3FS Operations Guide
item.description: Notes on some DeepSeek 3FS operations, continually updated. 1. Basic Concepts and Cautions Chain A Chain is made up of several Targets, and each Target is a replica of the storage. When all commits are ready, all Targets in a Chain are consistent. Targets on the same Chain cannot be on the same node.
